description:
With a set of familiar, intuitive moves that facilitate a consistent playstyle, Ryu is an excellent choice for everyone from beginners to experts.

Learn the character’s basic controls and moves to prepare for Street Fighter 6. Street Fighter 6 launches on June 2 on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam!
